a.lede: Microsoft announced today that devices running Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro editions have reached the end of support and will no longer receive monthly security and non-security preview updates. [...]
a.title: Microsoft: Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro reached end of support

b.lede: Microsoft has confirmed that non-admin users may be unable to connect to devices via Remote Desktop after installing recent Windows updates if the "Administrator protection" security feature is enabled. [...]
b.title: Microsoft: Recent Windows updates may trigger Remote Desktop failures
